title: EOS stress run — 10-agent full-system audit cycle
intent:
Run a fresh 10-agent EOS stress/audit cycle against current `main` as both a live EOS system test and a fresh full-system audit. Preserve current provider/cost/capacity/governance boundaries.

Required work:
Coordinate exactly 10 independent analysis workers. Use Agent Manager to prevent duplicate scope/drift and partition the review into materially distinct sectors.

Assign ten non-duplicative review sectors covering the current Taylor/Enterprise Operations OS system, including at minimum:
1. inventory integrity and transfer/receiving flows
2. work-order lifecycle and idempotency
3. dispatch/technician workflow and assignment logic
4. equipment/serialized assets/warranty
5. Firestore Rules and client call-site parity
6. Cloud Functions/callables/auth boundaries
7. EOS runtime/intake/completion semantics
8. Agent Manager concurrency/dedup/throttle/retry behavior
9. UI/UX workflow correctness and error handling
10. architecture/specification/governance drift and duplicate capability detection

Each worker must return findings with repository paths/evidence and severity. Agent Manager must consolidate and deduplicate the ten outputs into one durable result, explicitly identifying agreements, conflicts, duplicates removed, and cross-sector risks.

Completion:
Do not mark COMPLETE merely because workers exited successfully. COMPLETE requires all 10 worker results plus the consolidated Agent Manager report. If any worker is blocked/throttled/fails, record the real non-complete state and retry only under existing bounded EOS policy.
scope: Analysis-only (`READ_ONLY_ANALYSIS`) whole-system read across the repository. No source edits, merges, deploys, credential changes, or other protected actions.
